bugs.error_message: Race condition: closing buffer causes content from closed buffer to overwrite active buffer content. Symptoms: after closing tab, reopening shows wrong content even after git discard.
bugs.root_cause: save_current_text_buffer_history() was called with stale active_buffer_index after buffer removal. The function would save closed buffer's content (still in self.text) into wrong buffer slot. Also, self.text was not reset after clearing active_buffer_index, allowing stale content to persist.
bugs.fix: 1. Added bounds check in save_current_text_buffer_history() to prevent saving when old_idx >= buffers.len(). 2. Reset self.text and cached_line_starts immediately after clearing active_buffer_index in close_current_buffer() to prevent stale content from being saved during next activate_buffer_index() call.

bugs.error_message: Data loss when opening special buffers (Settings, Terminal, Help, References, Diagnostics, Fuzzy Picker): unsaved changes in current text buffer are lost without being saved to buffer history.
bugs.root_cause: All open_*_buffer() functions (open_settings_buffer, open_terminal_buffer, open_help_buffer, open_references_buffer, open_diagnostics_buffer, open_pending_references_buffer) and register_open_text_buffer() directly set active_buffer_index without calling save_current_text_buffer_history() first. This causes unsaved changes in the current text buffer to be lost when switching to special buffers.
bugs.fix: Added save_current_text_buffer_history() call at the beginning of: open_diagnostics_buffer(), open_terminal_buffer(), open_help_buffer(), open_references_buffer(), open_pending_references_buffer(), open_settings_buffer(), and register_open_text_buffer(). Note: open_fuzzy_picker_buffer() already had this fix.

bugs.error_message: F12 (FocusTerminal), ToggleTerminal, and ToggleBottomDock open terminal panel and focus it, but don't enter TerminalFocus mode, so text input doesn't work.
bugs.root_cause: When opening terminal panel, the commands set focus_manager to BottomPanel and spawn terminal tab, but never call apply_mode_event(ModeEvent::FocusTerminal) to transition from Normal/Insert/Visual mode into TerminalFocus mode. Without the mode transition, keyboard input is not routed to the terminal.
bugs.fix: Added apply_mode_event(ModeEvent::FocusTerminal) call after opening terminal in all three commands: FocusTerminal (line 218-220), ToggleTerminal (line 78-82), and ToggleBottomDock (line 115-117). This ensures the editor enters TerminalFocus mode when terminal panel opens, enabling text input.

bugs.error_message: Explorer paste conflict prompt (when pasting file with duplicate name) shows command palette to rename, but doesn't accept text input - user cannot type to edit the filename.
bugs.root_cause: ExplorerPasteConflict mode handler (lines 205-223) only matched FilePickerAppendQuery and FilePickerBackspaceQuery commands, but did not match the actual typing commands (InsertChar, InsertText, Backspace) that are generated by keyboard input. Other explorer prompts (ExplorerCreateFile, ExplorerRenameFull, etc.) were handled correctly in the next match arm (lines 224-278) which included all typing commands.
bugs.fix: Added InsertChar, InsertText, and Backspace to the ExplorerPasteConflict pattern match (lines 205-220). Changed the handler to use dispatch_palette_overlay_command() like other explorer prompts, which properly routes typing commands to the palette text buffer.
